Evan CS: quick sync for HarborView private/VPC onboarding 1: focus on log delivery chain (forwarder -> proxy -> SIEM), IAM trust for cross-account write, KMS access, and audit retention. Renewal rep asked for green by next Wednesday. What are the current blockers?
Pri (HarborView): primary issues: our forwarder times out to the proxy, and audit entries aren't showing in the SIEM. Also we need the exact role ARN to allow in our sidecar's trust policy.
Maya (Net): checking network 1: proxy shows TCP resets from the forwarder IP range. Pri, can you confirm the NAT egress CIDR?
Pri (HarborView): egress CIDR is 10.18.4.0/24 (NAT gateway).
Maya (Net): thanks. I'll add a targeted route and open tcp/514, tcp/6514 only to the proxy IPs. ETA 20m. Snippet: "gcloud compute firewall-rules create hv-logs-out --direction=EGRESS --dest-ranges 34.72.88.12/32,34.72.88.13/32 --rules tcp:514,tcp:6514 --network private-net"
Luis (SE): IAM: use role arn: arn:aws:iam::555444333222:role/harborview-log-writer. Also for KMS, we recommend adding a policy allowing kms:Encrypt/Decrypt for that role with condition on EncryptionContext key=source=harborview.
Sam (Security): agreed. Minimal KMS snippet: {"Sid":"AllowHarborView","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555444333222:role/harborview-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:source":"harborview"}}} Apply to the CMK.
Pri (HarborView): KMS policy change OK. We prefer rotation window Thu 01:00 UTC.
Evan CS: action items: 1) Maya open egress to proxy IPs (ETA 20m). 2) Sam finalize policy json and drop in shared drive (ETA 1h). 3) Luis schedule rotation Thu 01:00 UTC and invite HarborView. 4) Pri to run post-change SIEM ingest and paste one sample. Renewal check Wed 1: flag if audit still failing.
deploy-bot: forwarder-deploy #882 status: success.
Maya (Net): firewall rules applied, verified TCP connect from a test instance to 34.72.88.12:6514.
Pri (HarborView): re-tested after NAT rule change 1: now getting 202 ACKs. sample: "{\"ts\":\"2026-03-22T02:15:00Z\",\"status\":202,\"msg\":\"ingest accepted\"}"
Evan CS: nice, marking thread in-flight. I'll post a brief health note tomorrow before the renewal touchpoint. If anything regresses, escalate to CS lead.
